Title: Fresh Local Produce Every Thursday
Body: Exciting news! Starting this week, Killbuck Valley Mushrooms and Flying J Farm will be delivering fresh seasonal produce every Thursday morning. Get here early for the best selection!

Title: Extended Summer Hours Begin May 15
Body: Starting May 15th, we will be open until 9pm Monday through Friday. Weekend hours remain the same: Saturday 9am-8pm and Sunday Noon-6pm. Thank you for your continued support!

Title: Board Election Results 2026
Body: Congratulations to our newly elected board members. Thank you to all member-owners who participated in this year's democratic process. Results are posted on the bulletin board in store.

Title: Annual Meeting
Body: Join us for our annual member potluck and meeting on August 23, 2026 at 6:00 at Fred Fuller Park, Shelter #2 (near the restroom).  We will review this year's financials, elect board members and celebrate our community together.  Please bring a dish to share.  Beverages are provided
